name: finsider
description: Financial diligence with Finsider: inspect evidence, verify statements, and prepare reviewable reports.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Finsider account to assess an engagement, inspect financial statements and verification findings, ask Fin, and prepare diligence reports. Financial values come from Finsider calculations; each change requires approval and conclusions remain subject to professional review.
defaultPrompt: Assess diligence readiness for my Finsider workspace.
Explain the verification findings for my selected period.
Prepare a verified diligence report for professional review.
